action.command: docker exec urbo-workspace-spring-app-1 sh -c 'curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8081/health' 2>&1; echo "=== try actuator via proxy ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Host: api.workspace.localhost" http://127.0.0.1/actuator/health; curl -s -H "Host: api.workspace.localhost" http://127.0.0.1/actuator/health 2>&1 | head -c 300

tool_call.name: terminal
